author: Vieillot, 1817
habitat: 바닷가 섬의 덤불, 저수지와 습지 주변의 덤불
summary: 우리나라에서는 2004년 4월 하태도에서 처음 기록된 뒤 거의 해마다 봄·가을 이동기에 서해와 남해의 섬에서 기록되고, 겨울에 저수지나 습지 주변에서 겨울을 나는 개체도 드물게 보이는 길잃은새다. 국내에 오는 것은 시베리아에서 번식하고 인도 쪽에서 겨울을 나는 아종 tristis 로, 몸에 노란빛이 거의 없고 다리가 검다. 덤불과 낮은 나무 사이를 부지런히 옮겨 다니며 곤충을 잡고, 먹이를 찾을 때 꼬리를 아래로 까딱이는 버릇이 있다.

similar.how: 연노랑솔새는 다리가 연한 분홍빛 갈색이고 날개끝이 길게 나오며 아랫면이 더 노랗지만, 검은다리솔새는 다리가 검고 날개끝이 짧다.

art.subject: Common Chiffchaff (Phylloscopus collybita), adult of the Siberian race tristis, as seen in Korea in late autumn: upperparts cold grey-brown with a faint olive-green tinge only on the rump and the edges of the wing and tail feathers; buffish-white supercilium and a dark eye-stripe; a thin pale crescent below the eye; ear-coverts and breast sides warm buff; underparts off-white with buff flanks; no wing-bars; a small yellow patch only at the bend of the wing and on the underwing. Bill fine and blackish; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: flitting through low bare twigs with the tail dipped downward, side view
art.scene: low scrub and reed edges on a Korean offshore island in late autumn, bare twigs and dry grass; no people, buildings or text
views: adult of the Siberian race tristis, late autumn, side view perched on a bare twig with the tail dipped: buffish-white supercilium, dark eye-stripe, warm buff ear-coverts, fine blackish bill, grey-brown upperparts with greenish edges to the wing and tail feathers, whitish underparts with buff breast sides and flanks, blackish legs
adult tristis, three-quarter front view on a twig: buffish-white supercilium, warm buff ear-coverts and breast sides, whitish throat and belly with no yellow, fine blackish bill, thin blackish legs
art.build: Tiny leaf warbler, clearly smaller than a sparrow, slim and round-headed. Bill short, fine and straight, much shorter than the head. Legs thin, black. Wings short: at rest the primary tips extend only a short way beyond the tertials and end well before the tail tip. Tail medium length, square-ended, habitually dipped downward while feeding. Restless, flicking its wings as it picks insects from twigs and reed edges.
avoid: Do not paint bright olive-green upperparts and yellow underparts like western chiffchaffs or Willow Warbler; tristis looks grey-brown and buff.
Do not give it wing-bars (Arctic Warbler, Yellow-browed Warbler).
Do not paint pale pinkish legs or a pale bill; legs and bill are blackish.
Do not make the supercilium long, bold and white like Dusky Warbler (Phylloscopus fuscatus).
